description: Return the connected user's saved sidereal birth chart (their Kundli) without exposing stored birth details or internal identifiers. Includes houses (bhavas), house lords and graha drishti. Optional include sections: divisional_charts (D9 Navamsa, D10 Dasamsa), yogas (Raja and Dhana yogas), planet_strength (classical Shadbala in rupas, BPHS). Free with a connected Vedara account that has a completed birth profile. Operates only within the connected user's bounded private Vedara account. Uses saved or explicitly supplied coordinates and Vedara calculations, without public geocoding, web search, external recipients, or public publishing. Authentication, audit events, and rate limits are private account operations.
name: get_my_chart
title: Get my saved Vedic birth chart
